title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
description: An updated classic: egg noodles and tuna in a creamy mushroom sauce made from scratch, with peas and a crunchy cheddar crumb top.

image.alt: A casserole of noodles, tuna and peas under a crisp crumb topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 375F oven}. Cook the noodles in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the package says; drain.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms and onion until the mushrooms are browned and the onion soft, {time 8 min}.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for {time 1 min}. Slowly whisk in the broth and milk and simmer, stirring, until thick and creamy, {time 4-5 min}. Season with the salt.
Fold in the noodles, tuna, peas and half the cheese, and spread in the baking dish.
Melt the remaining butter, toss it with the panko and the rest of the cheese, and scatter over the top. Bake until bubbling and golden, {time 20-25 min}.

notes: Assemble up to a day ahead (keep the crumb topping separate) and bake straight from the fridge, adding 10 minutes.
